answer: The strongest lever is simple: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because harbor only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, vault is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any cipher approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
